title: Cheapy but cheery
text: Cheapy but cheery. Meh... just okay. For the price, I expect a nicer stocking. Some cheap pompoms glued to it and felt leaves for the holy. Not impressed with that. I’d say these stockings are a step up from ones you’d get from the dollar store but not much. Luckily these stocks are just for my husband and I so it’s not that big of deal. But just know they aren’t made of the best material. They are cheery looking though
